sources.title: PDF ProVore® 1 HP Grinder Pumps,Installation Manual
sources.snippet: Manual PRG-Series pumps ("M" suffix) require a separate, approved pump control device or panel for automatic operation. Operation will be according to the control selected. Refer to separate manufacturer's instructions supplied with the unit. Verify the electrical specifications for the control panel properly match those of the pump.

sources.title: PRG102M - Liberty Pumps PRG102M - PRG Series - Manual Residential ...
sources.snippet: Oil-filled, thermally protected motor PRG-Series residential grinders can be used as a replacement pump in 2" discharge systems using LE40 and LE50-series solids-handling pumps.* *PRG-Series flow rates do not exactly match LE-series flow rates. Consult us with actual application and head specifications prior to replacing LE40 and LE50 series pumps.

sources.title: PRG-Series 1 HP Grinder Sewage Pump with 10 ft. Cord and Float Switch
sources.snippet: Improve your plumbing system with a sewage pump from Liberty Pumps PRG-Series. This pump is designed for sewage applications. It also features higher flow rates that allow use with 2 in. discharge lines.
